title: Page map
description: Every page of the site, grouped by section: the home page's map.

body.description: Optional: rendered markdown shown under the groups, across the width of the sections beside the guide: on the home page, the page's markdown body. A region of its own, named by its first heading (page.headings), when it has one

bodyTitle.description: Optional: a heading for body, written above it, when the body's own markdown has none (the home page's sites, placed in a region). The section is then named by it

bodyNote.description: Optional: the note under bodyTitle, like a group's note

page.description: What Pattern Dump works out for the page: page.headings, whose first heading names the body's region

nav.description: The site's navigation: the storefront fills it from the pages, one level deep

description.description: A section's muted line; a guide step's line under its title
